definitions.explanation: Days from Monday to Friday, working days.

examples.japanese: {平日|へいじつ}は{仕事|しごと}。
{平日|へいじつ}だけ{営業|えいぎょう}。
{平日|へいじつ}は{毎朝|まいあさ}6{時|じ}に{起|お}きる。
examples.english: I wake up at 6 every morning on weekdays.

examples.japanese: {平日|へいじつ}に{休|やす}みを{取|と}ると、どこも{空|す}いていて{快適|かいてき}だ。
examples.english: When I take a day off on a weekday, everywhere is empty and comfortable.

notes:
{平日|へいじつ} refers to ordinary weekdays (Monday through Friday).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {平日|へいじつ}のみ (weekdays only)
- {平日|へいじつ}{料金|りょうきん} (weekday rate)
- {平日|へいじつ}ダイヤ (weekday schedule)

CONTRAST:
- {平日|へいじつ}: weekday
- {休日|きゅうじつ}: holiday/day off
- {祝日|しゅくじつ}: national holiday
- {週末|しゅうまつ}: weekend
